options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a consequence of a real fact, not a hypothetical result, so it does not complete an inverted conditional.

options.why_wrong: A future-tense completion does not match the past hypothetical meaning of the inverted conditional.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'had' and a conditional perfect in the main clause
explanation: In an inverted conditional, 'had' moves to the front and replaces 'if'. The main clause then needs a conditional perfect ('would have' plus a past participle) to express an unreal past result. Ukrainian expresses unreal past meaning with a past verb plus a separate conditional particle, so learners may leave the main verb in a simple form or use a simple future; the conditional perfect is the target here.
